findings.title: From header unusable for DMARC
findings.description: The message has 2 From headers. DMARC cannot be applied reliably; receivers commonly reject such messages.
findings.recommendation: A message must have exactly one From header with one mailbox. Multiple or malformed From headers are a common spoofing technique.

findings.title: Header that must be unique appears more than once
findings.subject: From
findings.recommendation: Different software picks different instances of duplicated headers; this is used to show one identity to filters and another to users.

findings.title: Message is not DKIM-signed
findings.description: The message has no DKIM-Signature. Its content and From domain are not cryptographically authenticated.
findings.recommendation: Without DKIM, DMARC can only pass through SPF, which breaks on forwarding.

findings.title: Malformed header section
findings.description: The header section does not conform to RFC 5322.
evidence: leading-continuation-line: continuation line before the first header field
whitespace-before-colon: header field "Subject" has whitespace before the colon (obsolete syntax)
malformed-header-line: line "This line is not a header: but looks like one" is not a valid header field; treating it as the start of the body
no-body-separator: the header section is not terminated by an empty line
findings.recommendation: Malformed headers are parsed differently by different software and are used to hide or smuggle header fields. Treat the message with suspicion.

findings.title: Message-ID missing
findings.subject: Message-ID
findings.description: The message has no Message-ID header.
findings.recommendation: Legitimate mail systems add a Message-ID; its absence is common in bulk and malicious mail.

findings.title: No Authentication-Results headers
findings.description: The message carries no Authentication-Results headers to compare with.

findings.title: SPF inputs inferred from message headers
findings.description: SPF inputs were reconstructed from message headers, which the sender can forge above the receiving organization's boundary. Confirm them with --source-ip, --helo and --mail-from from the receiving MTA's logs.

findings.title: SPF not evaluated
findings.description: The MAIL FROM identity is unknown, so the SPF result used by DMARC could not be computed (HELO mail.test.example: none). Pass --mail-from or analyse a message with a Return-Path header.
